frame_reverse.label: Reversed injected frames — no oral performance

reading.measurement: The difference between these auditory inputs takes a repeatable temporal form in the modeled downstream response. Among the selected half-second episodes, the largest average separation falls at 21.1–21.6 seconds, with 8/8 seeds in the same direction.
reading.functional_limit: The pooled descending population does not meet the temporal criterion. These measurements do not establish a differentiated disposition toward bodily action.
reading.affect_reading: Through an affect-theory lens, the encounter is articulated in time: the disturbance has a repeatable course rather than only a total magnitude. The apparatus makes these changing relations available to interpretation, while leaving subjective experience inaccessible. At 21.1–21.6 seconds, the comparison produces a higher downstream firing-rate response relative to silence than the reference. This local contrast can be read as uneven recruitment over time, without assigning an emotional value.
reading.qualification: The affect reading is a theoretical extrapolation from a modeled encounter, not a report of what a living fly felt. Selected episodes are exploratory, not independently validated discoveries.
